answer.rationale: The 14-day expiry and 94% line utilization make an unvalidated primary-supplier migration materially risky despite the low-cost quote meeting the spend mandate. The incumbent has demonstrated delivery and integration stability, while prior benchmarking-based negotiation improved incumbent pricing and payment terms. First verify that negotiation evidence, then pursue an accelerated, benchmark-backed incumbent renewal that targets the 18% reduction without disrupting supply; the low-cost quote provides negotiation leverage rather than an automatic switch decision.
